proof_body:
by
  intro A _ _ _ _ a l z hl hz
  by_contra hlt
  push Not at hlt
  have hl' : IsUnit (algebraMap ℂ A l - a) := hl
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hl'
  have hr : resolvent a l = ((u⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A) := by simp [resolvent, ← hu]
  rw [hr] at hlt
  have hnorm : ‖(algebraMap ℂ A z - a) - (u : A)‖ < ‖((u⁻¹ : Aˣ) : A)‖⁻¹ := by
    rw [hu]
    have : algebraMap ℂ A z - a - (algebraMap ℂ A l - a) = algebraMap ℂ A (z - l) := by
      rw [map_sub]; abel
    rw [this, norm_algebraMap', norm_sub_rev]
    exact hlt
  exact hz (Units.ofNearby u _ hnorm).isUnit |>.elim
target_source: ∀ (A : Type*) [NormedRing A] [NormedAlgebra ℂ A] [NormOneClass A] [CompleteSpace A] (a : A) (l z : ℂ), l ∈ resolventSet ℂ a → z ∈ spectrum ℂ a → ‖resolvent a l‖⁻¹ ≤ ‖l - z‖
